forChurches: Youth-heavy, worship-led churches: students, young adults and young families who meet on Sunday nights as much as Sunday mornings.

church.name: Lampstand Church
church.nameCheck: One web search on 2026-11-19 for "Lampstand Church" Columbus Ohio found no church by that exact name in Columbus.
church.addressNote: Foundry Row is a made-up street. The map links point to the Short North neighborhood.
church.timesNote: The 10 AM gathering has Lampstand Kids (nursery to fifth grade). Students and young adults fill the 6 PM gathering, which is also live on YouTube.
church.pastorsLine: Lead pastors Andre and Talia, a married couple who started Lampstand in 2019 in the back room of a Short North coffee shop, with a handful of college friends and one guitar.
church.missionLine: Nobody lights a lamp to hide it. We gather to shine together, then carry that light into every corner of Columbus.
church.announcement: We are buying the Foundry. A campaign to buy and renovate the hall the church already rents.
church.currentSeries: Lamps On (part 3: Shine where you are, November 15, 2026, Talia)

palette.name: Kiln
palette.role: Ground: page background, header, footer. Warm near-black, never pure black.

palette.name: Soot
palette.role: Raised ground: reviews band, dropdown menus, chat sheet, brand board tiles.

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: All headlines and primary text; the chat circle.

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Quiet text: lead paragraphs, captions, notes, footer base line.

palette.name: Flare
palette.role: The one accent: primary buttons, the changing hero word, label marks, the next steps band, play tiles, number chips. Flat only, never a glow or gradient.

palette.name: Umber
palette.role: Quiet text on the Flare band so titles stay loudest.

palette.name: Vesper
palette.role: Deep violet used once per page: the announcement bar.

palette.name: Char
palette.role: Rules and borders only. Never used for text.

contrastMethod: WCAG 2.x relative luminance formula, computed with a Node script; every text pair is at least 4.5:1.

display.use: Headlines, numbers, card titles, the wordmark. Set in caps by the display style (copy is written in sentence case), tracking 0 to -1%, line height 0.84 to 0.95.

body.use: Body 17px at 1.6, lead 19.5px, labels 12.5px 600 caps at +16% tracking, buttons 16px 600.

shapes.radius: 2px on buttons, fields and tags; 0 on photos and cards. The chat circle and the pulse play are the only round things.
shapes.rules: 1px Char hairlines between sections and inside lists; a 3px Flare bar before every label; label rows run a hairline to the right edge; 4 to 5px strike lines on next steps.
shapes.buttons: One filled Flare button per view with Kiln text; outline buttons in Bone at 55% border. 52px tall, 44px small. Paired buttons share one width. Arrows on primary buttons and text links only.
signatureDetails: Viewfinder corners in Flare on two key photos
A reel line (thin progress bar) for things that play

motion.character: Stage lights switching on: quick, decisive and warm. Fast expo-out easing (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), short staggers, hard-edged panels. Energetic but never bouncy or glowing.
pieces: Hero photo drifts slowly (28 second push and pan) in place of a film
Hero lines rise in on load; the changing word slides out upward, then the next slides up from below, never overlapping
Sections and photos rise 30px into place as they scroll in (reveal-init then reveal-in, hidden state added only after the observer exists)
Next steps columns rise one by one and a Kiln strike line draws across each, then settles to a short mark
Hovering a next step wipes a Kiln panel up from the bottom, turns the title Bone and runs the line full width in Flare
Photo cards: the photo pushes in, a Flare bar wipes across its bottom edge and the title turns Flare
Primary buttons: a sheen sweeps across once on arrival and a soft light follows the cursor, inside the button only
Photo strip scrolls slowly, pauses on hover or focus, with a Pause Motion button that stops every moving part
Reviews rotate every 6.5 seconds with a reel line showing time left, paused on hover or focus
Scroll progress line under the header; slight parallax on the statement band
motion.reducedMotion: Everything stops: no drift, no word swap, no strip scroll, no autoplay, no reveals (content is simply shown).

photoTreatment.grade: Warm stage and tungsten light, amber highlights, deep warm shadows crushed toward Kiln, slightly lower saturation, a touch more contrast.
photoTreatment.layout: Photos are full bleed or hard-edged rectangles with no radius. Text over photos always sits on a Kiln shade on one side; on phones the photo sits above the words.
photoTreatment.subjects: Adults and students mid-moment: worship, greeting, prayer, baptism, serving, small groups. Kids only in groups.
photoTreatment.source: 14 Unsplash License photos, credits in photos/CREDITS.md

logo.concept: A lampstand built from four flat bars with a single flame on top (Matthew 5:15, a lamp on a stand gives light to everyone in the house), beside a heavy condensed wordmark: LAMPSTAND in Big Shoulders Display Black with +3% tracking.
lockups: Primary: mark left of the wordmark
Stacked: mark above the wordmark with COLUMBUS between two Flare dashes
Small mark: the lampstand alone on Flare, Kiln, Bone or Vesper squares and circles
logo.colorRule: The flame is always Flare (or Kiln when the whole mark sits on Flare). The stand takes the text color of its ground.
logo.clearSpace: Equal to the flame height on all sides

templatePreviewBadge: A small outlined 'Template preview' tag sits in the header beside the logo on every page and is repeated in the footer base line.

tints.name: Vesper tint
tints.role: Second line of text on the Vesper announcement bar only.

tints.name: Soot 2
tints.role: Hover ground inside menus and chat bubbles.

contrastScript: contrast-check.mjs (run with node); every text pair is at least 4.5:1, last checked 2026-11-19.
